QuestInfo.name: [Temple of Time] Seeking Lost Memories
QuestInfo.0: According to the Memory Keeper, in order to find my lost memory, I need to go back to the starting point of my adventure.  Starting point of my adventure? Let's see... Wouldn't that be when I left Maple Island to Victoria Island for the first time and got my job?  I should go see #b#p1101002##k.
QuestInfo.1: It had been a long time since I last met with #p1101002#.  He said he remembered when I was just a Noblesse and I knew nothing. He was happy to see how I've grown into a great knight.  I was touched that he still remembered our first meeting from such a long time ago.
